summary: VEHIQ Iteration 2 testing complete. Backend: 18/18 NEW iter2 tests PASS + 39/39 iter1 regression tests PASS = 57/57. Frontend: Dashboard, password-reset (request/confirm), 404 page, forgot-password link, empty states all working.
critical_code_review_comments: fire_and_forget(asyncio.create_task) requires running event loop — fine inside FastAPI request handlers; if ever called from sync context it will fail. Currently safe.

tpl_new_message/tpl_forum_reply HTML embeds raw user-provided strings (sender_name, listing_title, preview, thread_title) — XSS vector if email client renders HTML. Recommend html.escape() on user-controlled vars before insertion.

/api/auth/password-reset/request leaks no info on unknown email (good) but currently makes no rate-limit, allowing email enumeration via timing/SMTP-error logs. Consider rate limiting (note: in-memory rate limiting was already flagged in iter1 and out of scope).
Email templates use inline strings — fine for 5 templates. If more are added, move to Jinja2.
/api/auth/password-reset/confirm returns 401 when JWT decoding fails (decode_token raises 401), not 400 as docstring suggests. Test still passes (accepts 400 or 401).

seed_data_creation: Tests create temporary users, vehicles, listings, threads, comments — all isolated under unique UUID prefix. No cleanup required as they don't interfere with subsequent runs.

Dashboard at /garage now shows full layout with reminders strip, stats cards, RECENT ACTIVITY widget, MARKETPLACE HIGHLIGHTS widget, empty state with Car icon. /password-reset, /password-reset/confirm, /404 routes all work. Iteration 1 issues (in-memory rate limiting, partial PUT) intentionally left as-is.
